gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta: Stencil cut, loud and tall. Snowburst One carries the page with wide bridges and generous openings, while Mukta stays tucked beneath in tall-bodied plain sans letters that never compete.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-malar: Expressive, right away. Snowburst One splashes stencil bridges across the top, and Mukta Malar answers in a compressed, approachable sans-serif that hands the spotlight back without a fuss.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-narnoor: Bold stencil letters take the lead in Snowburst One, with wide bridges cutting through each shape. And Narnoor follows in a sans with short ascenders over big bowls, keeping everything below easy to take in.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-displa: Stencil gaps and tall lowercase give Snowburst One a loud, cut-paper look up top, before the text begins. Noto Sans Display then settles into a sans with a big middle zone, friendly and steady.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ramabhadra: Cut-stencil boldness, tall and loud. Snowburst One brings the wide bridges and sprung openings, and Ramabhadra follows in a sans whose prominent x-height keeps the lines below clear and sturdy.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-secular-one: Wide stencil bridges mark Snowburst One. Its hollow, tube-like lettering turns a bit fussy if the heading shrinks, while Secular One, a sans with a dominant midsection, looks heavy if the body goes large.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sofia-sans-conde: Sofia Sans Condensed reads tight and friendly. Its big x-height and unshaded curves sit well beneath Snowburst One, though a slightly larger body size would give its narrow sans-serif letters more room.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-truculenta: Stencil cuts, wide and showy. Snowburst One handles the loud, tall headline work, while Truculenta keeps its compact sans lines crowded and rounded, with short ascenders over a tall x-height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yantramanav: Stencil boldness, sprung wide open. Snowburst One brings the drama, and Yantramanav tucks in beneath with tall lowercase almost reaching its capitals, a modern sans that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-outfit: Loud stencil cuts, tall lowercase throughout. Snowburst One strikes hard up top, then Outfit, a sans-serif of cable-like curves that stop short of closing, lowers the volume with a friendly, moderate height.
